claim_register.claim: The2024 Day1 design requires booking entity and its home-currency business calendar; duplicate rule conditions are prohibited. It supports VD,VD-1,VD-2 plus time, exclusion conditions, and manual/auto flag. Currency-pair and extra-key support are outside Day1. Its changes affect only new cashflows; queued historical items require Operations attention. Rules do not cross-net; earliest scheduled job wins competing matches. Auto-rule checks follow manual-rule checks and precede multiple exceptions. PendingAutoNetting permits warned SettleGross and warned manual net; bulkGross remains questioned. Suppress,failed,hold follow its disabled PendingNetting scope. Manual net can combine PendingNetting,PendingAutoNetting,PendingException. A single cashflow exits to exception checks with SingleCashflow. Late arrivals use manual-netting queue. Unnet bypasses automatic-rule checking and returns NSTP. These dated positions conflict with later Day2 statements and are not current defaults.

claim_register.claim: The enhancement asks to remove automatic affirmation. Interentity and Other resultant proposals become Unaffirmed with PendingAffirmation. Different-trade components need Operations approval; same-trade components can use trade-match status to close the exception. CCS resultants and CCS gross cashflows become Unaffirmed and trade-match status can close PendingAffirmation. Clearing resultants and gross cashflows remain SwiftSuppressed while Unaffirmed. Interentity gross behavior is unchanged by the proposal. Other gross becomes Unaffirmed with PendingAffirmation when trade-match status is absent. IRS remains separate and unaffected. A new PendingNettingAffirmation exception is only good-to-have, and removing mandatory manual-net affirmation remains for discussion.

claim_register.claim: The clearing agreement requests LCH/HKEX/ECLIPS netting of IRS aggregation with other cashflows sharing entity,counterparty,currency,paymentdate, then automatic Swift suppression. Named netting times are HKEX/ECLIPS01:00GMT and LCH12:00GMT onVD. Type is Clearing_Swift_Suppress.
